name: Cinema Manager Simulator
detailed_description:
Cinema Manager Simulator 🎬 is a first-person simulation and management game where you take control of your very own cinema.

Manage every detail of your cinema, from upgrading projectors and sound systems to customising the lobby, setting ticket prices, and licensing movies.

Key Features:

🎥 First-Person Immersion – Experience the thrill of running a cinema firsthand. Walk through your theater, interact with equipment, and engage with customers.

🍿Supply & Customisation – Purchase new seats, projectors, screens, popcorn machines, and more. Customise your cinema’s interior to attract more customers.

📽️ Movie Licensing & Scheduling – Buy movie licenses, schedule premieres, and manage ticket prices based on demand and trends.

🏗️ Expand & Upgrade – Expand your cinema by opening new halls, or even a luxury screening hall. Invest in high-performance technology to automate tasks and improve efficiency.

🧑‍💼 Hire & Manage Staff – Recruit cashiers, cleaners, projectionists, and even electricians to keep everything running smoothly. Balance wages and efficiency for maximum profit.

💡 Realistic Challenges & Repairs – Equipment can break down at crucial moments. If too many outdated machines are in use, power outages might occur—forcing you to manually restore electricity or hire an electrician.

📊 Tablet Management Hub – Control everything from your tablet, including financial reports, online orders, customer reviews, and movie scheduling. Take loans, pay bills, and track your cinema’s success.

Can you create the ultimate movie-watching experience and build a cinema empire? In Cinema Manager Simulator, every decision shapes your journey to becoming the biggest name in the industry!
